earliest_failed_contract: An exact extrema report for current terrain must clip its actual physical triangles. After installing Owned support, the retained sample grid is extent/material metadata; independently reconstructed header-grid triangles cannot establish where the actual piecewise-linear surface has extrema.
counterexample: Admit SceneTerrain::from_heightmap(2,2,2.0, four zero heights), whose extent is[-1,1] squared. Build BoundedSettlementTerrain::from_foundations with no foundations and four finite natural triangles forming a tent: square corners(-1,-1),(1,-1),(1,1),(-1,1) at elevation0, joined around interior point(.25,.25) at elevation2. Its finite/source cardinality/query admission accepts this unambiguous natural topology. Install it via with_property_surface. terrain_extrema over the square footprint reconstructs only header triangles[a,b,d] and[b,c,d]; clipping produces only square corners, each actual height0, so maximum_metres is0 and complete_playable_coverage istrue. Actual owned height_at at(.25,.25) is2 and the owned mesh/collider use the tent. The routine never visits that actual source vertex. No fixture or numerical code was executed.
actual_recipient: inspect-city-grounding.rs main passes generated.terrain into inspect; inspect289 emits terrain_extrema under playable_footprint_terrain. Occupied generation installs Owned terrain, and property_support/queries explicitly ignore header-grid physical topology thereafter. The report method text calls the output linear terrain-triangle extrema and reports complete header coverage.
qualification: The two current footprint fixtures1984 use Sampled terrain, where the reconstructed b--d grid is the actual source and their intended results agree. The witness is a valid public/admitted Owned surface; no claim that a currently shipped building has exactly this tent or that its ordinary report was run. Complete_playable_coverage currently means corner containment in header extent, not proof every actual support triangle was examined. Main report does not certify whole route/collider/renderer acceptance; the finding is wrong reported extrema within its own stated bounded method.

connected_repair: Derive diagnostic extrema from the actual physical GeographicSurface/owned triangles at the inspected terrain, clipping that source against the requested footprint. Share the source selection with height/query/render/collider ownership, and keep header extent containment distinct from measured triangle coverage. Preserve current Sampled anti-diagonal behavior and explicit outside/partial/missing coverage; do not rebuild Owned support from its material grid.
acceptance: An admitted owned subgrid peak inside the requested footprint is included in reported extrema even when absent from all retained header-grid vertices/diagonals. Existing Sampled fixtures retain exact extrema and source-order policy. Missing or partial physical coverage stays explicit. No new tests or execution in this audit.
